Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/rest-channel.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (the CEILINGS rows and MAX_LINE_BYTES), scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs and scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs (the read-back judge, read for flag ③-2), scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs, scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs and scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (the mechanical readers of platform-readings.md), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/reading-discipline.md

Inputs: card #24729 body and all five comments (6282030487, 6282315049, 6282690769, 6282735695, 6283021321); PR #24744 body, file list and net diff against main — the API diff and a local `git diff origin/main...branch` agree byte for byte modulo index lines (merge base 7e7e605de3; origin/main at 4a2ca57e74 touches neither file); the 38 check-runs on this head; the director ledger block 6281946060. Governing text: the card's 「What done looks like」, the filer's second reading 6282030487, the triage grading 6282315049 (p3, ⛔ no new gate). No letter ruling exists on this card. Isolated read: the dispatch order and the dispatching seat's conclusions were not inputs.

Check-runs on the head: all 38 completed; every conclusion is success or skipped, none failure. Required set — Lint & Repo Gates success, TypeScript Type Check success, Test Core success, Governed Surface Queue Guard success, Build Core skipped (path-selected on a two-file docs diff). Check Changeset, Check PR Size, the claim guard and the single-writer guard: success.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept set and public surface: the diff is two governed `.claude/**` reference files, 3 insertions / 3 deletions, no script, no gate, no changeset, no package. It implies no accept-set change and no public-surface change. Right.
- Line ratchet: both files stay at their CEILINGS rows (platform-readings 460/460, rest-channel 82/82, `MAX_LINE_BYTES = 120`). Measured from `git show` on the branch: L245 = 116 B, L246 = 120 B, rest-channel L30 = 119 B; no line in either file exceeds 120 B. The dev's `line_budget` is the file's. Right.
- (a) The compression of the MCP entity-escape pair into one line loses no reading another line or script relies on. Tree grep at origin/main: 「存储体是明文」, 「往返安全」, 「腐蚀 body」, 「原样回写」, 「转义读数」 occur only on the deleted L246. The one phrase another line depends on, 「解码后写回」 (L251 「追加按解码后写回执行」), is kept on the new L245, so L251 still resolves to a stated procedure; the deleted failure-mode sentence is subsumed by L254 「⛔ 不拿有损读数回写」. L249's 「⛔ 两类不并成一条」 is respected: the merge joins the two read-side-artefact lines, not the read-side and the write-side classes. The mechanical readers of this file read other content — check-required-contexts.mjs the required-context names, check-governed-queue-guard.mjs the queue-membership phrase, check-half-states.mjs the 配额段 token-class fact, post-stamped.mjs cites :410–:411 — none touches L245–L250, and the head's Lint & Repo Gates is green. reading-discipline.md carries no entity-escape reading. Right.
- (b) The new fact line 「代理侧 REST 读的 body 间歇把裸 `#N` 展开成 `owner/repo#N`:重写前折回本仓前缀或核长等原长。」 states the ruled content and nothing more: proxy side and REST read (the card's 「proxy side」), 间歇 (6282030487: 「intermittent on the read path, not a switch that stays flipped」), the expansion shape, and the remedy as the ruled disjunction before a body rewrite — collapse the own-repo prefix, or prove the fetched length against the raw length. It does not copy the card body's 「every bare #N」, which the dev's own reading falsifies; it names no figure, no issue id, no gate. Right.
- (c) 「配额段」 is the right pointer target. L245–L250 sit under 〈API 配额〉 (L92–L259); 〈读数陷阱〉 opens at L261. rest-channel.md already points there at L3 and L59, and the ruling the ratchet quotes at check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:1137 — 「`platform-readings.md` 配额段独家持有,`rest-channel.md` 只留指路」 — is exactly this shape: a pointer, no restatement. The dispatch's 〈读数陷阱〉 premise was wrong on origin/main; the dev corrected it and declared it under `deviations`. Right. Non-blocking: the pointer hangs on the comment-thread row (L30), while the measured expansion also reaches issue bodies read by `GET .../issues/{n}` (L29's row; the director post #12708 read with 117 expansions). L30 was the only row with byte headroom, and the fact line itself says 「REST 读的 body」 generically, so the table is right and the pointer is one door to it.
- (d) The dev's repro readings do not contradict the line as written. 40 expansions on comment 6279597228 nine seconds after a 0-expansion read of the card thread is the intermittency the line states. Three bare references left unrewritten after an opening parenthesis is why the line must not say 「every」, and it does not. The length arithmetic — 5,667 chars − 40 × 26 = 4,627 (4,711 bytes) against the card's stated raw 4,673, reconciling in neither unit — is a figure on the card's side (the ledger's 「3,088 more bytes」 reconciles with neither 5,667 − 4,673 nor 117 × 26 = 3,042 either); the line carries no figure, and its length leg is precisely the arm that catches a collapse that does not restore. The director-post figures do add up (17,699 − 3,042 = 14,657). The dev's 「not decidable without a raw read」 is the honest reading. Right.
- Governance: draft, auto-merge off, Tier S by path; the landing waits on this record and the owning seat. Right.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` on the PR body matches the claim 6282690769 and the diff: nothing published moves, no package is touched, `.changeset/` is untouched, the `skip-changeset` label is on the PR and Check Changeset is green. `skip-changeset` is the correct declaration for a `.claude/**`-only diff. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none.
- Flag 1 — 〈读数陷阱〉 L313 「GitHub 存储字节完好、raw REST 一字不差 ⇒ ⛔ 不单凭 MCP 读判截断,先取 raw 或渲染页核对。」 now holds for the angle-bracket dimension only. Answered: the clause is scoped by its own line to the tag-shaped truncation, which the expansion does not touch, and its prescription (fetch raw or the rendered page before judging truncation) stands; the new L246 sits in the same table. No edit is owed in this PR (outside the dispatched landing, zero headroom). Carried in the PR's acceptance notes per os-dev.md (carrier none ⇒ acceptance notes only); the seat may tighten L313 to name its dimension in the next platform-readings edit, paid in place.
- Flag 2 — `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` judges a sent body by a seat-side REST read-back. Escalated to the owning seat. Read in the cited code: the header (L121–L150) says the body read-back is the SEAT's — 「only the SEAT, which holds the bytes it meant, can」 — so it runs in the container, on the very read path the card measures; `post-stamped.mjs classifyReadBack` (L2617–L2650) admits five classes only (identical, trailing-newline-stripped, the three footer shapes) and everything else is `mutated` ⇒ `not-stored`, exit 4, with the printed remedy 「Go READ what is stored and send a body that can land」 (dispatch.mjs L745–L750); a comment is located by its sent bytes, so an expanded listing reads `unverified`, exit 6. While the expansion is active, a correctly stored body carrying bare references is therefore judged not landed, and the remedy sends the seat to read the expanded body — the card's trap through the tool's own door. Not reproduced: the dev's pr_create read back identical with a bare reference, and the filer's ledger writes read back identical in the same minutes the expansion was seen on another read, consistent with 6282030487's intermittency (the card's 「relay read-back unaffected, on the runner」 names the executor's echo, a different leg from the seat-side judge the header names). The card's remedy is a seat habit and reaches no script, and the triage grading says ⛔ no new gate; so this is a tooling `finding` for the seat to file under gate ① with the evidence above (class: a tool verdict wrong by construction while the proxy rewrite is active; producer: the proxy-side rewrite on the seat's read path; reach: `not-stored` or `unverified` on a landed body), or to leave as the acceptance note until reproduced — the seat's call, outside this PR's dispatched surface. Does not bear on this verdict.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-24729-rest-read-reference-expansion`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读(终稿)· PR #24744 · `domain:skills` seat 1 · `os-justin` · `session_01HEdP5tPhqQfzwRmKDxwn85` · 2026-10-20T04:11Z

- **改了什么:** 平台读数事实表加一条:容器里经代理的 REST 读回的正文,会间歇地把裸 `#N` 展开成 `owner/repo#N`;据这种读数重写正文之前,先把本仓前缀折回,或核对取回长度等于原长。原有 MCP 实体转义两行压成一行付账(处方「解码后写回」保留,删去「往返安全」「腐蚀成因」两句解释);REST 通道表评论线那一行加指路。两文件行数不变(460/460、82/82)。
- **为什么改:** 总监席当班实测:自己写入的开轮标记(35 处裸 `#N`,中继回读一致)经 REST 读回时带 40 处 `objectstack-ai/objectstack#N`;几分钟后同路径又读回 0 处。席位若拿这种读数去改写卡片正文,写入成功、回读也一致,卡片里的引用却被静默改成长格式。dev 在本容器复现一次(40 处展开,紧跟左括号的 3 处裸引用未被改写)。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 纯文档 3 行;不加门禁、不动上限;回滚即还原本 PR。代价:MCP 那条少了两句解释;dev 另记两条不立卡的旁注(〈读数陷阱〉第 313 行「raw REST 一字不差」在新事实下只对尖括号维度成立;`fleet-write` 回读在展开生效期间可能读回比发送长)。
- **席位意见:** 接受。事实行按立卡席的第二读数写「间歇」,处方两选一与卡文一致;指针指向该行实际所在的配额段(派发令误写成读数陷阱段,dev 当众更正)。
- **你要做的:** 无。Tier S,席位在达档复核 PASS、全部检查转绿后入队。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** draft、base `main`、首行 `Fixes #24729`、行首 `Clause-②: no`、assignee `os-justin`、`skip-changeset` 随创建同笔(REST 回读 labels = documentation, size/xs, skip-changeset);2 文件 +3/−3,一个提交;正文页脚 1 条(会话 URL 形);闭合关键词只有首行一处(另引 #12708 与括号内 `(#7144` `(#2767` `(#2066` 读数旁无动词)。
- **前提实测(席位,`origin/main` `9b2953d62`→`7e7e605de` 与分支 tip `e1f639ebf`):** 新第 245/246 行 116/120 字节、`rest-channel.md` 第 30 行 119 字节,皆 ≤120;两文件 460/460、82/82;第 245–250 行确在〈API 配额〉(92–259)而非〈读数陷阱〉(261 起)—— 派发令的节名与行号(第 31 行)两处误读,dev 实测更正,记入接受的偏差。
- **门禁 check-runs(head `e1f639ebf`):** 2026-10-20T04:11Z 38 条(34 名),24 success、10 skipped、0 failed、0 in_progress;`Lint & Repo Gates` 与 `TypeScript Type Check` 均 success 且 `head_sha` 钉 `e1f639ebf`;`check-expected-skips --pr 24744`:OK,12 条跳过全在名单(exit 0);`check-governed-merges --pr 24744`:GOVERNED,Tier S(`.claude/**` ×2),6 行。dev 本地 20 条派生门禁全 0,`--ran` 20/20,钉 head `e1f639ebf`。
- **接受的偏差:** 派发令节名/行号误读(上);两行方案装不下(85+86+89 > 240 字节)改为「MCP 对压一行 + REST 一行」,删句内容在 PR 正文逐字列出;基点 `7e7e605de`(两文件两处读数相同);`doc-formula-expressions` 首跑 exit 3 为前置未建,锁下补建后 0;两次 push;中继 `pr_create` 回读行不列 label(读数 ⑱,REST 回读证实);三次读数(复现一次 + full+json 一次 + 对照一次)是三个问题,非轮询。
- **复核记录:** 隔离达档复审 **PASS** 6283172819(`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`,head `e1f639ebf`,Local-runs none;范围扩到棘轮脚本、`fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`、`post-stamped.mjs`、三个机械读者脚本与 `reading-discipline.md`)。① 压行无损:被删短语全树仅见于旧第 246 行,第 251 行依赖的「解码后写回」保留,失效形态由第 254 行承接;② 指针目标 `配额段` 正确(棘轮引的裁决原话即「配额段独家持有、rest-channel 只留指路」);非判决项:指针挂在评论线行,而展开也及 `GET .../issues/{n}` 的正文行 —— 事实行本身写的是泛指的「REST 读的 body」,本席照收。③ 旁注一(第 313 行「raw REST 一字不差」只对尖括号维度成立)已答:该句自限于 tag 形截断,处方仍立,下次改 `platform-readings.md` 时就地收紧,记指针;旁注二升级到本席:`post-stamped.mjs classifyReadBack` 只认五类回读,展开生效时一个已正确落库、含裸 `#N` 的正文会被判 `mutated ⇒ not-stored`(exit 4)或 `unverified`(exit 6),且打印的处方让席位去读那份被展开的正文 —— 代码读出的确定路径,未端到端复现。本席按立卡门 ① 立一张 `tooling` finding(具名生产者 = 代理侧改写;落点 = 回读判定器),卡号记在落地评论与座位贴。
- **范围外去向:** dev 两条 carrier-none 旁注 —— 〈读数陷阱〉第 313 行的「raw REST 一字不差」在新事实下只对尖括号维度成立;`fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` 席位侧回读在展开生效期间可能读回比发送长(推断,本轮 7,534/7,534 未复现)—— 记座位贴 Carried pointers,不立卡;卡的原长 4,673 与 dev 折算 4,627 字符/4,711 字节不合,单位或折回不精确未决,同记。
- **落地条款:** Tier S;达档复核记录 PASS 在案(6283172819)后由本席 `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` 入队。

**ACCEPT**
